description: exp457 redo with ZERO-INIT branch Linear (weight+bias=0). exp457 used default nn.Linear init -> branch output std ~0.58 dominated the base LUT (std ~0.005-0.02) by 30-120x at init, polluting early convergence (+0.083 at step 200). Zero-init makes the combined module start IDENTICAL to exp453; the VectorToDominance->Linear 'main effect' is learned purely as an additive correction that grows in (cf. exp326). Each LUT module = base TinyMHLut (unchanged, on LION) + parallel V2D(hard +/-1 STE, full triu)->Linear (dense, on AdamW). Tests whether a clean low-noise main-effect speeds convergence vs exp453 (1.4967). Saves checkpoint.
